kv4.5:1.3: arahā chahi phassehi chahi vedanāhi chahi saññāhi …pe… chahi paññāhi samannāgato’ti.
kv4.5:2.3: arahā cakkhunā rūpaṃ passanto sotena saddaṃ suṇāti, ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyati, jivhāya rasaṃ sāyati. kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusati, manasā dhammaṃ vijānāti;
kv4.5:2.4: manasā dhammaṃ vijānanto cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati …pe… sotena saddaṃ suṇāti …pe… ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyati …pe… jivhāya rasaṃ sāyati …pe… kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusatī’ti. pa paṭi:
kv4.5:3.3: sattaṃ samitaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ chahi upekkhāhi samannāgato samohito cha upekkhāyo paccupaṭṭhitā’ti.
